implementationScope: package-only progressive JFIF 4:2:0 incremental session with semantic-unit marker streaming, cadence-aware output/render lifetime, first-SOS quantization-source release and actual-only persistent coefficient planes

cases.mechanismPressure: 23x13 has Y actual geometry 3x2 but interleaved-MCU syntax geometry 4x2; single-byte scheduling forces dummy DC blocks through suspend/rollback while proving only six actual Y coefficient blocks persist
72x72 Y block geometry is already MCU-aligned, so v8 must preserve v7 retained/peak values while exercising the 414-byte transaction transport on a 132270-byte scan
aligned 8x8 Y block geometry plus 342 split restart markers proves the coefficient-layout change does not widen rollback scratch or alter restart suspension semantics

requiredInvariants: All v7 transport, marker streaming, JFIF/Adobe authority, quantization-source lifetime, cadence-aware output, RenderArena and transactional-MCU invariants remain unchanged.
SOF2 still publishes MCU-padded Y syntax geometry for interleaved entropy traversal, but the persistent coefficient plane contains only yActualWidthBlocks*yActualHeightBlocks image blocks.
Single-component AC scans, rasterization and block smoothing already address only actual image geometry; padded Y blocks therefore have no cross-scan image-state authority.

Interleaved DC-first dummy Y blocks are still fully Huffman-decoded and update the shared Y DC predictor before being discarded. Interleaved DC-refine dummy blocks still consume exactly one refinement bit each; their prior coefficient values cannot affect later entropy state.

Streaming snapshots/restores only persistent image blocks. At an edge MCU the unused tail of the existing six-block rollback arena supplies one reusable 128-byte dummy block, so operationScratchByteCharge remains exactly 768 bytes.

One-shot decode uses one equivalent 128-byte temporary dummy block during entropy parsing. That phase scratch is strictly smaller than the already-admitted render scratch and does not widen the one-shot operation peak.
Persistent Y coefficient bytes equal actual Y block count times 64 Int16 values; coefficientStateBytes equals Y plus two chroma planes.

The 23x13 witness has actual Y geometry 3x2, padded syntax geometry 4x2, yCoefficientBytes 768 instead of the historical 1024, coefficientStateBytes 1280, persistentStateBytes 4056, renderScratchBytes 2752 and totalStateBytes 6808.
For the 23x13 every-preview session, pre-finish retained state is 5367 bytes and operation peak is 8119 bytes; final RGB remains byte-identical to the complete decoder.
The 576x576 and 64x64 controls have no Y padding, so their v8 resource ledgers remain exactly equal to v7: 998518/2010934 bytes and 15478/30518 bytes retained/peak respectively.
Terminal finish/cancel/fatal failure still publishes zero codec-owned retained/operation/output state.
This profile does not qualify public DecodedImage color representation, non-JFIF semantics, embedded ICC, other sampling modes, physical RSS, allocator headers or perceptual reconstruction quality.
